faq.title: Common questions about billing.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our plans and pricing.
faq.q1: How does the 14-day free trial work?
faq.a1: You get full access to all features on your chosen plan for 14 days. No credit card required to start. If you decide not to continue, your account is simply paused — no charges.
faq.q2: What counts as an AI minute?
faq.a2: An AI minute is one minute of active call time handled by your voice agent. Hold time, ringing, and system processing are not counted. Only actual conversation time is billed.
faq.q3: What happens if I exceed my included minutes?
faq.a3: You'll be billed at your plan's overage rate for any minutes beyond your monthly allocation. Starter plans pay {{starter}}, Pro pays {{pro}}, and Enterprise pays {{enterprise}}.
faq.q4: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a4: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time from your account settings. When upgrading, you get immediate access to the new features. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
faq.q5: Are there any contracts or commitments?
faq.a5: No. All plans are month-to-month with no long-term contracts. You can cancel at any time and your account will remain active through the end of your current billing period.
faq.a6: Yes. Annual billing saves you 20% compared to monthly pricing. Contact our sales team or select annual billing during signup to get the discounted rate.
faq.a7: No setup fees on any plan. Starter and Pro plans are entirely self-service. Enterprise plans include dedicated onboarding at no additional cost.
faq.q8: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a8: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and ACH bank transfers for annual Enterprise plans. Invoicing is available for Enterprise customers.

medical-intake.name: Medical Intake Agent
medical-intake.description: Handles after-hours patient calls with clinical intake protocols. Triages urgency, schedules appointments, and escalates critical concerns to on-call providers.
conversation: Hi, I need to schedule a follow-up appointment with Dr. Chen.
Of course! I can help you schedule that. Could you provide your date of birth so I can pull up your records?
Sure, it's March 15, 1985.
Thank you. I see your chart. Dr. Chen has openings this Thursday at 2 PM or Friday at 10 AM. Which works better for you?
Thursday at 2 works.
You're confirmed for Thursday at 2 PM with Dr. Chen. You'll receive a confirmation text shortly. Is there anything else I can help with?
workflow_steps: Route to scheduling, triage, or refill flow
medical-intake.escalation_behavior: Immediately escalates to on-call provider for symptoms indicating emergencies (chest pain, difficulty breathing, severe bleeding). Non-urgent after-hours requests are queued for morning review.

dental-scheduling.name: Dental Scheduling Agent
dental-scheduling.description: Manages dental appointment scheduling, hygiene recall campaigns, and patient communication. Handles overflow calls during peak hours.
conversation: I need to reschedule my cleaning appointment.
I'd be happy to help with that. Can I get your name and the date of your current appointment?
It's Lisa Martinez, I have something next Tuesday.
I found your appointment for Tuesday at 9 AM. I have Wednesday at 11 AM or Thursday at 3 PM available. Would either work?
Wednesday at 11 is perfect.
Done! Your cleaning is now Wednesday at 11 AM. We'll send you a reminder the day before.
dental-scheduling.escalation_behavior: Dental emergencies (severe pain, knocked-out tooth, excessive bleeding) are transferred to the on-call dentist. Insurance disputes are queued for billing staff.

legal-intake.name: Legal Intake Agent
legal-intake.description: Conducts structured legal intake conversations 24/7. Captures case details, qualifies leads, and routes to the appropriate practice area attorney.
conversation: I was in a car accident last week and I think I need a lawyer.
I'm sorry to hear about your accident. I can help connect you with the right attorney. Can you tell me when and where the accident occurred?
It was last Thursday on Route 9. The other driver ran a red light.
Thank you. Were you injured? And have you received any medical treatment?
Yes, I went to the ER for whiplash and my back has been hurting.

I've noted all of that. This sounds like a personal injury case. I'm flagging this as high priority and an attorney from our PI team will call you back within 2 hours. Can I confirm your callback number?
workflow_steps: Assign to practice area & schedule callback
legal-intake.escalation_behavior: Time-sensitive matters (upcoming court dates, statute of limitations within 30 days) are immediately escalated to the managing partner. Criminal matters with clients in custody trigger emergency contact protocols.

hvac-home-services.name: HVAC / Home Services Agent
hvac-home-services.description: Handles service calls for HVAC, plumbing, and home services companies. Triages emergencies, dispatches technicians, and sends customers real-time ETAs.
conversation: My AC stopped working and it's 95 degrees in the house.
I'm sorry to hear that — let me get you help right away. Can I get your name and address?
It's Mike Torres, 412 Birch Lane.
Thank you, Mike. Is anyone in the home who is elderly or has a medical condition affected by the heat?
No, just me and my wife.

Got it. I'm dispatching a technician now — they should arrive within 2 hours. You'll receive a text with their name and live ETA. In the meantime, stay hydrated and close your blinds to keep the heat out.
workflow_steps: Send SMS with tech name & ETA
hvac-home-services.escalation_behavior: Gas leaks, carbon monoxide alerts, and no-heat emergencies in extreme cold trigger immediate dispatch and safety guidance. Non-urgent requests are scheduled for the next available window.

outbound-sales.name: Outbound Sales Agent
outbound-sales.description: Runs automated outbound calling campaigns for lead qualification, appointment setting, and follow-up sequences with answering machine detection.
conversation: Hi, this is Alex calling from Bright Solutions. We spoke briefly at the trade show last week. Do you have a moment?
Oh yes, I remember. We were interested in your scheduling product.
Great! I'd love to set up a 15-minute demo with our product team. Would this Thursday or Friday afternoon work for you?
Friday at 2 PM would be good.
Perfect — I'll send a calendar invite to your email on file. Before that, could you tell me how many locations you're currently managing?
We have about 12 offices across the state.
That's helpful context for our team. You're all set for Friday at 2 PM. You'll get a confirmation email shortly. Thanks for your time!
workflow_steps: Detect answering machine vs. live pickup
outbound-sales.escalation_behavior: High-value leads (enterprise tier, 10+ locations) are immediately warm-transferred to a senior sales rep. Do-not-call requests are logged and the number is added to the suppression list.

customer-support.name: Customer Support Agent
customer-support.description: Provides first-line customer support for common inquiries, troubleshooting, and ticket creation. Handles high call volumes with consistent quality.
conversation: I'm having trouble logging into my account.
I can help with that. Could you provide the email address associated with your account?
It's john@example.com.
I found your account. It looks like your password was reset recently. I've just sent a new password reset link to your email. You should receive it within a minute.
Got it, thanks!
You're welcome! If you have any other issues after resetting, don't hesitate to call back. Have a great day!
customer-support.escalation_behavior: Issues unresolved after two troubleshooting attempts are escalated to a human agent with full context. VIP customers are immediately routed to senior support.

insurance-verification.name: Insurance Verification Agent
insurance-verification.description: Automates insurance eligibility checks, benefits verification, and prior authorization follow-ups for medical and dental practices.
conversation: I need to check if my insurance covers an MRI.
I can look into that for you. May I have your insurance provider and member ID number?
Blue Cross, member ID BX-445521.

Thank you. I'm checking your benefits now. Your plan covers diagnostic MRIs at 80% after your deductible. Your remaining deductible is $350. Would you like me to provide a cost estimate for your visit?
insurance-verification.escalation_behavior: Denied prior authorizations are escalated to the billing team with denial reason codes. Patients with lapsed coverage are connected to the financial counselor.

appointment-reminder.name: Appointment Reminder Agent
appointment-reminder.description: Proactively contacts patients and clients to confirm upcoming appointments, handle rescheduling, and reduce no-show rates.
conversation: Hi, this is a reminder from Westside Medical. You have an appointment with Dr. Patel tomorrow at 10:30 AM. Can you confirm you'll be there?
Actually, I need to push it back. Can I come in the afternoon instead?
Of course. Dr. Patel has 2:15 PM and 3:45 PM available tomorrow afternoon. Which would you prefer?
2:15 works.
You're rescheduled for 2:15 PM tomorrow with Dr. Patel. We'll send a confirmation text. See you then!
appointment-reminder.escalation_behavior: Patients who miss multiple appointments are flagged for office manager review. Same-day cancellations trigger waitlist backfill automation.

property-management.name: Property Management Agent
property-management.description: Handles tenant maintenance requests, emergency after-hours calls, and lease inquiries for property management companies. Triages urgency and dispatches maintenance staff.
conversation: Hi, my kitchen faucet is leaking pretty badly.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me help get that resolved. Can I get your name and unit number?
It's Sarah Mitchell, unit 304 at Parkview Apartments.
Thank you, Sarah. Is the leak contained, or is water actively flooding?
It's dripping steadily but not flooding.

Got it. I've created a maintenance request and flagged it as urgent. A plumber will contact you within 4 hours to schedule a visit. You'll get an SMS with the details. In the meantime, try turning off the water valve under the sink.
property-management.escalation_behavior: Active flooding, gas leaks, fire damage, and no-heat emergencies in winter are immediately escalated to the on-call maintenance supervisor with simultaneous tenant safety guidance.

restaurant.name: Restaurant Agent
restaurant.description: Manages reservations, takeout orders, and general inquiries for restaurants. Handles peak-hour overflow calls and after-hours booking requests.
conversation: Hi, I'd like to make a reservation for this Saturday.
Of course! How many guests and what time were you thinking?
Party of 6, around 7 PM.
Let me check availability. I have 6:45 PM or 7:30 PM open for a party of 6 this Saturday. Which works better?
7:30 is perfect. And does anyone in the kitchen handle nut allergies?
Yes, our kitchen accommodates nut allergies — I'll add that note to your reservation. You're confirmed for 7:30 PM this Saturday, party of 6. You'll receive a confirmation text shortly.
workflow_steps: Greet caller and identify request type
Confirm booking details and dietary needs
restaurant.escalation_behavior: Large party requests (12+), private event inquiries, and catering requests are transferred to the restaurant manager. Complaints about food quality or service are flagged for manager callback within 1 hour.

real-estate.name: Real Estate Agent
real-estate.description: Captures buyer and seller leads, answers property listing questions, and schedules showings automatically. Integrates with MLS and CRM systems.
conversation: I saw the listing on Oak Street. Is it still available?
Yes, the property at 215 Oak Street is still on the market! It's a 3-bedroom, 2-bath listed at $425,000. Would you like to schedule a showing?
Yes, what's available this weekend?
I have Saturday at 11 AM or Sunday at 2 PM. Which works better for you?
Saturday at 11.
You're confirmed for a showing at 215 Oak Street, Saturday at 11 AM. Can I get your name and email to send the listing details and confirmation?

real-estate.escalation_behavior: Pre-approved buyers ready to make offers are immediately connected to the listing agent. Seller inquiries about listing their property are routed to the team lead.
